title: Sketchpad Design Scene From Elements
description: Replace the 3D scene in semio/sketchpad design app with the scene from elements (@elements/scene via TopologyScenePane). Wire representations, selection, hover, drag-drop, and relocate; remove dead legacy SemioScene path.
summary: Continued cleanup: wired design topology onBoardHover to DESIGN.SET_HOVER for board↔scene hover chrome; removed dead useThree import; updated embedded Design Playwright test to use elements board/scene selectors (topology roots, board-text-overlay, board canvas pan/drag) instead of react-flow DOM; connector selection via actor when WASM handles have no DOM.
